style: Create ONE production game character asset. Reference image is STYLE, CAMERA and TWO-CELL LAYOUT reference only. Replace its stone soldier with SUBJECT. Exactly TWO equal square cells side by side in one wide transparent PNG: LEFT is front facing straight DOWN toward image bottom, RIGHT is identical unit's BACK facing straight UP. Elevated orthographic 45-degree overhead view, see top of head/shoulders, no profile, no diagonal facing. Very simple chunky matte toy shapes, same large-head short-limb proportions as reference. Only 3-tone broad shading, no textures, tiny ornaments, realistic anatomy or fine detail. Each unit full-body centered at x25% and x75%, feet at y85%, equal scale, height70% image, generous transparent margins including all weapons. Weapons shift correctly between front and back. Readable at32px. Distinct role silhouette as specified. Soft upper-left light. NO text, floor, shadows, backgrounds, scenery, borders, extra characters. Genuine transparent alpha. Two idle directions, not animation frames.
promptFirst: Create one production game sprite asset of a simple STONE AGE STONE AXE INFANTRY for Portal Master. One transparent PNG with exactly TWO equal square cells side by side. LEFT cell: character facing straight DOWN toward bottom of image, seen from elevated orthographic 45-degree overhead camera. RIGHT cell: SAME character facing straight UP toward top of image, rear of head and back visible, same overhead camera. Absolutely NOT side-facing or profile, NOT isometric diagonal orientation. Full body in each cell, centered, feet at 85% cell height, height 70% cell, generous empty transparent margins. Character: tiny compact tan-hide tunic, short dark hair, ONE large simple grey stone axe in right hand, bare short legs. Slim small infantry silhouette, no shield. Cute chunky toy game soldier, head 40% body height, short limbs, simple broad matte clay shapes with 3-tone shading, no fine textures, fingers, stitching, fur strands, facial wrinkles or intricate ornament. Muted warm beige/brown, one small jade band for ally identification. Readable at 32 pixels tall. Soft upper-left light. Transparent empty background with alpha, no ground, no floor, no drop shadow, no scene, no text, no grid, no borders, no extra weapons or extra characters. Same character size in both cells. This is a two-direction idle sprite, not concept illustration.
